protocol.attention_count: Dense QK and AV matrix products, no causal triangle discount.
protocol.counted: Attention and MLP matrices, recurrent injection, coda, and vocabulary head.
protocol.excluded: Embedding lookup, normalization, RoPE, activations, biases, residual additions, and guidance vector arithmetic.
protocol.paper_source: sources/looped_qwen/loopcd.html, Appendix D.1 and Tables A7-A9

flops_512_token_prefill.accounting_difference: The printed Huginn TFLOPs match the Transformer blocks and head with dense attention. Including the released core_block_forward's 2d-to-d injection matrix adds one projection per recurrent step. Both ledgers are shown; the injection-inclusive ledger counts all forward matrix products.

bootstrap.method: Independent within-task paired multinomial resampling of corrected/regressed/unchanged questions; percentile 95% CI for equal-task mean delta.

permutation.method: Independent paired sign flips conditional on each task's correctness discordances, Binomial(discordant,0.5); statistic 100 times the equal-task mean delta; plus-one two-sided Monte Carlo p.
permutation.rng: Each contrast and resampling method starts a separate NumPy default_rng(1234).

multiplicity.primary_macro: Holm over the three primary macro sign-flip tests.
multiplicity.primary_tasks: Holm over the twelve primary exact McNemar tests: four tasks times three contrasts.
multiplicity.individual_reports: The original within-task Holm adjustment over three contrasts is also retained under mcnemar_holm_adjusted_p.

statistical_protocol.secondary_views: All-acc and all-acc_norm means and task differences are descriptive; the frozen primary metrics determine primary inference.
statistical_protocol.stability: Wins/ties/losses count task-level accuracy changes, without treating task count as a separate significance test.
